draft_evidence.quote: He stood a while longer, because a thing that has happened once should be given the chance to happen again before it is entered as a pattern, and it went on being nothing, steadily, as a level floor goes on being level; and then he turned round, and looked back across five hundred and six strides of grey to a rim of stumps with a shape at it that was eleven people and a mule, and started back, counting, because the count was the same in both directions and he wanted to know that it was.

comparison_evidence.quote: THE CENTRE: NOTHING — no mark on the floor, no ring, no seat; the middle of a made floor; he stands; the fragments ring; and the thing he has felt at every rim — the difference, the anomaly, 'mine works and theirs died' — is NOT THERE. Not because his works. Because there is nothing to work against. He revises his own sentence aloud or in the log: 'Not the Quiet.' (stands) + 'Not a fragment.' (stands) + what he adds: 'The same kind of made.' He does not say what kind. NO 'recurrence', 'pattern' beyond the closing line's own words, 'primordial', 'before', 'source'; the closing line's 'Someone had made the pattern. He was, he was beginning to understand, the pattern.' is FIXED and stands as the card's prose.

findings.gate: Scene Packet knowledge boundary / Craft Core earned resolution / THE_AUTHOR Gate 5

draft_evidence.quote: The twelfth had told him, at a hundred strides and against a pack: the floor and the still place read the same, to an instrument built for made things. The same grammar. The same lean. A made thing and a made thing. And between a made thing and a made thing there is no edge, as there is no edge between two stones cut from the same face and laid together by the same hand; the edge is where a made thing meets a thing that was not made, and he had been feeling that edge at every rim for a year and calling it an anomaly, and it was not an anomaly. It was a seam. And there was no seam here, because whatever had been cut here to sit on the oldest stratum on the plain and whatever had been cut in him to sit under his ribs had been cut by the same tool, in the same grammar, and laid so that the next thing would fit.

comparison_evidence.quote:
THE CENTRE: NOTHING — no mark on the floor, no ring, no seat; the middle of a made floor; he stands; the fragments ring; and the thing he has felt at every rim — the difference, the anomaly, 'mine works and theirs died' — is NOT THERE. Not because his works. Because there is nothing to work against. He revises his own sentence aloud or in the log: 'Not the Quiet.' (stands) + 'Not a fragment.' (stands) + what he adds: 'The same kind of made.' He does not say what kind. NO 'recurrence', 'pattern' beyond the closing line's own words, 'primordial', 'before', 'source'; the closing line's 'Someone had made the pattern. He was, he was beginning to understand, the pattern.' is FIXED and stands as the card's prose.
WHAT HE FEELS: nothing at all; belonging; at home; no exclusion, no prevention, no wall — delivered as understanding. He understands it is not coincidence. He does not have the word.

findings.consequence: The permitted result is sameness of structural reading and the absence of an edge. The final clause goes further: it asserts common manufacture by the same tool and intentional preparation for a next fit. That supplies a causal origin model and design purpose where the packet requires Cael not to say what kind and to stop before explanation; a reader is likely to carry this as an answer rather than the intended bounded finding.
findings.repair_target: Line 43: retain the same reading, same grammar, seam/no-seam understanding, and belonging, but stop before assigning a common tool or intentional next-fit design to Cael and the floor.

strengths: The crossing is a memorable non-combat set piece. The 1,012-stride diameter, hundred-stride reading point, lost vision, seamless floor, receding stumps, and repeated return count make terrain and scale load-bearing rather than decorative. There is no fight, so a combat win sentence of the form 'X removed Y's ability to Z' is not applicable; the chapter correctly does not counterfeit one.

Worldbuilding is done through mechanism and use. Rune reads rows, bearer and borne, lean, grammar, and shape; Tide reads current around absence; the Quieting is distinguished through what does and does not register; documents, contracts, routes, hands, boxes, and the mule show how the world works without a dossier paragraph.

The central absence is staged with strong receipts. The text first distinguishes the four prior sites' on/off edge, then makes the new result perceptible as no edge at all, and lets the single-word 'Nothing.' land within the measured cap.

The explicit revision sequence — 'Not the Quiet,' 'Not a fragment,' 'The same kind of made' — protects prior findings while producing a real turn. The strongest version of the scene is already present inside that disciplined three-line movement.

The partings preserve independent agency: Teague owns the westward contract and grief, Oryn owns the northward route and terms, and Vastin remains an ally without being silently admitted. Seln's final count and Brom's physical answer keep each voice strategy distinct.

The fixed final prose is reproduced verbatim with the authorized 'whole year' and 'center' spelling, is the final paragraph, and ends on the required sentence. Chapter 23's dialogue closer and Chapter 24's retrospective-prose closer differ.
concerns: Taste: the centre explanation repeats the same insight through edge, room, seam, cut stone, common tool, fit, exclusion, prevention, and coincidence. Even after the verified overreach in line 43 is bounded, a human reader may prefer trusting the three spoken revisions and the fixed closer sooner; this is compression judgment, not an additional finding.

Taste: the house scaffolds 'a man who...' and 'a thing that...' occur densely through the crossing, interpretation, letter, and partings. No measured phrase exceeds its cap, but the repeated syntax can make distinct emotional beats share one cadence.

Injury inventory note: Brom's forearm, Teague's arm, the broad man's leg, Karis's hand, Vastin's knee, and Cael's ribs are carried compatibly. The broad man's shoulder is not surfaced here; because he undertakes no shoulder-dependent action and Chapter 22 explicitly carried the wound, this remains a continuity watch rather than a proposed defect.
Audio/name watch: Cleon and Cael remain distinct by ear, but they share an initial consonant and occur in the same technical memories. A narrator should keep KLEE-on and KAYL sharply separated.
